details: The museum identifies George Groslier (1887–1945) as designer and records the April 1920 opening and the building’s traditional Khmer form.

Sokonthea Sort, Project and Planning Office, Department of Museum, conservation report pp. 7–10. Written account covers the three decorated roof pavilions, two east wings added by 1924, central/east gallery, brick walls, roof tiles and historical redetailing. Only written facts used.
The Musée Cernuschi physical copy COMP5 is catalogued as a Hanoi 1930 imprint. The page scanned in the EFEO booklet cites the exact March 1930 publication.
